title: #332 Separate Schools
prompt: Girls and boys should attend separate schools. Do you agree or disagree with the statement?

requirements.en: State how far you agree or disagree.
requirements.vi: Nêu mức độ đồng ý hoặc không đồng ý.

requirements.en: Support your position with two clear reasons.

promptTraps.en: Do not write a general essay about the topic without answering the exact task.

faq.questionEn: Can I use a personal example?
faq.questionVi: Tôi có thể dùng ví dụ cá nhân không?

faq.answerEn: Avoid memorised general sentences and any idea that does not answer the task.
faq.answerVi: Tránh câu chung học thuộc và mọi ý không trả lời đúng yêu cầu.

plans.label: Version 1: AGREE
plans.thesisFrame: In my view, Education should be considered from the perspective of agree.
plans.point1: The primary argument for separate schools is that they create an optimal academic setting, allowing students to concentrate on their studies without the distractions of mixed-gender social interactions.
plans.point2: A secondary benefit is that separate schools facilitate the development of gender-appropriate social skills, allowing students to build strong peer bonds within their own gender group.

plans.label: Version 2: DISAGREE
plans.thesisFrame: In my view, Education should be considered from the perspective of disagree.
plans.point1: Co-educational settings allow students to interact with diverse peers, helping them develop essential communication skills and build broader social networks, which fosters comprehensive personal growth.
plans.point2: Mixed schooling models realistic social interactions, allowing students to encounter different perspectives and become more adept at understanding varied gender roles and social cues.
